objective.goal: Freeze a prospective, outcome-blind MEAN_REVERSION coarse parameter-region scan design (preregistered SD-threshold x lookback-bar grid) over the Epoch46 accepted 33-symbol Wave01 cohort, generating event-density and dependence-adjusted effective-sample-size diagnostics per parameter cell without opening any post-event response statistic, PnL, or economic outcome.
objective.information_gain_rationale: MEAN_REVERSION is an open, non-blocked family with a preregistered event-density grid already computed on freshly accepted (Epoch46) outcome-blind M5 data spanning 33 heterogeneous structurally-distinct symbols (306k rows, 91 UTC date clusters, dependence-adjusted effective clusters ~55-59). This is the only open family with both (a) already-acquired sufficient data and (b) a predeclared, family-specific candidate grid ready for Stage-1 coarse scanning per the parameter-discovery governor, avoiding a generic Wave02 request and avoiding reuse of any already-observed diagnostic outcome. TREND_MOMENTUM's only fresh local result is transport-corrupt and CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING/RELATIVE_VALUE/CROSS_MARKET/SEASONALITY/BREAKOUT/CARRY are excluded or lack a ready predeclared design on this exact cohort, so MEAN_REVERSION offers the highest legal expected information gain right now.
